description: This file defines the ContentPickerFieldSettingsDriver class, which manages the editing and updating of ContentPickerField settings within OrchardCore CMS. It handles rendering the settings UI, validating input, and applying changes to the field configuration.

classes.name: ContentPickerFieldSettingsDriver
classes.description: A driver class responsible for rendering and processing the settings UI for ContentPickerField in OrchardCore.

methods.name: ContentPickerFieldSettingsDriver
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for the driver.

methods.description: Renders the settings editor UI for ContentPickerField.

methods.description: Processes the submitted settings form, validates input, and updates the field settings.
